question: Should this test-slimming change retain explicit guards for release-validation attempt selection and each credentialed publish job’s full provenance binding before it can merge?
rationale: The remaining question is not mechanical cleanup: it is the intended minimum security contract for release authorization and credentialed publishing automation.

options.title: Restore focused provenance guards
options.body: Keep the slimmed structure but add narrow table-driven assertions for the exact attempt lookup and per-job dependency, actor, ref, SHA, attempt, and parent-run bindings.

options.title: Accept reduced coverage
options.body: Merge only if the responsible owner explicitly accepts that these release authorization and publish provenance contracts are covered elsewhere with equivalent durable protection.

recommendation.title: Restore focused provenance guards
recommendation.body: Keep the slimmed structure but add narrow table-driven assertions for the exact attempt lookup and per-job dependency, actor, ref, SHA, attempt, and parent-run bindings.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the consolidation and documented the unresolved security-sensitive guard gaps at the current head.
